description: Draft the specification of the visitor's own project with Picodev's interview: you ask the visitor, this tool says what to ask next and makes the PDF. Nothing is sent and nothing is kept. Call it with the sections written so far (none at first). sections: {id: text in simple Markdown}, ids envelope, fonctionPrincipale, fonctions, alimentation, format, environnement, production, preferences, 4000 characters at most each. sections.contact, optional: the contact details the visitor wants printed at the end of the document (1000 characters at most; not part of the interview's progress). language: fr or en, the one the visitor answers in (headings, look_for and questions, the PDF). pdf=true: also the PDF, with Picodev Lab's template; requires title (one line). figures, with pdf=true, optional: the drawings the visitor approved, 3 at most, each {section (a section id), caption (one line), type (png or svg), data (base 64, 200 KiB at most decoded)}, placed after their section's text; an SVG loads nothing (no script, no DTD, href # or data:image/ only). Returns {rules (how to run the interview: follow them), sections [{id, heading, required, state (empty, thin, filled), look_for and questions while not filled}], next (the section to ask about, or null), ready (the four required sections filled: enough for Picodev to start), filename and pdf (base 64) with pdf=true}.
name: spec_draft
title: Draft a project spec
